test_cases.summary:
Verify backend allows creating a new duplicated session while original is locked
when the original session is locked
test_cases.description:
Feature: Locked Session – Backend Allows Duplicate Creation Only

Scenario: Verify backend allows creating a new duplicated session while original is locked

Given the original session is locked
When the user duplicates the session (new session creation request)
Then the system should allow duplication
And create a new session record successfully
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should allow duplication
The behavior should be validated when the user duplicates the session (new session creation request).

test_cases.summary:
Verify access denied response is safe and non-technical
when a session is locked
test_cases.description:
Feature: Locked Session – Access Denied Message Non-Technical

Scenario: Verify access denied response is safe and non-technical

Given a session is locked
When the user triggers a blocked update request
Then the system should return access denied response
And it should not expose internal server or stack details
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should return access denied response
The behavior should be validated when the user triggers a blocked update request.

test_cases.summary:
Verify session lock completes without noticeable delay
when the user is on Data Labelling Session list page
test_cases.description:
Feature: Lock Action – Quick Completion

Scenario: Verify session lock completes without noticeable delay

Given the user is on Data Labelling Session list page
When the user locks a Completed session with valid reason
Then the lock action should complete quickly
And lock state should reflect immediately in grid
test_cases.acceptance:
The lock action should complete quickly
The behavior should be validated when the user locks a Completed session with valid reason.

test_cases.summary:
Verify session unlock completes without noticeable delay
when a session is locked
test_cases.description:
Feature: Unlock Action – Quick Completion

Scenario: Verify session unlock completes without noticeable delay

Given a session is locked
When the user unlocks the session with valid reason
Then the unlock action should complete quickly
And session status should update to Re-open instantly
test_cases.acceptance:
The unlock action should complete quickly
The behavior should be validated when the user unlocks the session with valid reason.

test_cases.summary:
Verify loader is shown during lock/unlock processing
when the user triggers Lock or Unlock action
test_cases.description:
Feature: Lock/Unlock – Loader Visibility

Scenario: Verify loader is shown during lock/unlock processing

Given the user triggers Lock or Unlock action
When the system processes the request
Then a loader/processing indicator should be shown until completion
test_cases.acceptance:
A loader/processing indicator should be shown until completion
The behavior should be validated when the system processes the request.

test_cases.summary:
Verify grid refresh happens instantly without full page reload
when the session list page is open
test_cases.description:
Feature: Lock Action – Grid Refresh Without Full Page Reload

Scenario: Verify grid refresh happens instantly without full page reload

Given the session list page is open
When the user locks a session
Then the grid should refresh immediately
And the page should not fully reload
test_cases.acceptance:
The grid should refresh immediately
The behavior should be validated when the user locks a session.

test_cases.summary:
Verify retry option/message appears when lock action times out
when the user triggers lock/unlock action
test_cases.description:
Feature: Lock/Unlock Timeout Retry Handling

Scenario: Verify retry option/message appears when lock action times out

Given the user triggers lock/unlock action
When the request times out due to slow network/backend delay
Then the system should show retry option or timeout message
And user should be able to retry without breaking UI
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should show retry option or timeout message
The behavior should be validated when the request times out due to slow network/backend delay.

test_cases.summary:
Verify locked session is clearly identifiable in session list
when a session is locked successfully
test_cases.description:
Feature: Lock Status – Visual Indicator Visible

Scenario: Verify locked session is clearly identifiable in session list

Given a session is locked successfully
When the session list page is displayed
Then a lock icon/badge should be clearly visible for the locked session
test_cases.acceptance:
A lock icon/badge should be clearly visible for the locked session
The behavior should be validated when the session list page is displayed.

test_cases.summary:
Verify lock indicator is removed after unlocking session
when a session was locked and then unlocked
test_cases.description:
Feature: Unlock Status – Visual Indicator Removed

Scenario: Verify lock indicator is removed after unlocking session

Given a session was locked and then unlocked
When the session list refreshes
Then the lock icon/badge should no longer be visible
test_cases.acceptance:
The lock icon/badge should no longer be visible
The behavior should be validated when the session list refreshes.

test_cases.summary:
Verify tooltip displays lock reason clearly
when a session is locked with a reason
test_cases.description:
Feature: Lock Status – Tooltip Shows Reason

Scenario: Verify tooltip displays lock reason clearly

Given a session is locked with a reason
When the user hovers over the lock icon/badge
Then the tooltip should display “Session is locked. Reason: <reason>”
test_cases.acceptance:
The tooltip should display "Session is locked. Reason: <reason>"
The behavior should be validated when the user hovers over the lock icon/badge.

test_cases.summary:
Verify disabled actions are visually distinguishable for locked session
when a session is locked
test_cases.description:
Feature: Locked Session – Disabled Actions Visually Distinct

Scenario: Verify disabled actions are visually distinguishable for locked session

Given a session is locked
When the user views Edit/Delete actions
Then disabled actions should appear greyed out or hidden
And clearly indicate non-interactive state
test_cases.acceptance:
Disabled actions should appear greyed out or hidden
The behavior should be validated when the user views Edit/Delete actions.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Duplicate action is clearly available even when session is locked
when a session is locked
test_cases.description:
Feature: Locked Session – Duplicate Action Clearly Available

Scenario: Verify Duplicate action is clearly available even when session is locked

Given a session is locked
When the user views Actions column
Then Duplicate option should remain clearly enabled and usable
test_cases.acceptance:
Duplicate option should remain clearly enabled and usable
The behavior should be validated when the user views Actions column.

test_cases.summary:
Verify lock indicators remain clear after refresh or re-login
when a session is locked
test_cases.description:
Feature: Lock Status – Consistent Indicators Across Refresh

Scenario: Verify lock indicators remain clear after refresh or re-login

Given a session is locked
When the user refreshes the page or logs out and logs in again
Then the lock icon/badge and tooltip should still display correctly
test_cases.acceptance:
The lock icon/badge and tooltip should still display correctly
The behavior should be validated when the user refreshes the page or logs out and logs in again.

test_cases.summary:
Verify lock/unlock indicators do not confuse users
when multiple sessions exist (locked and unlocked)
test_cases.description:
Feature: Lock Status – No Ambiguous Messaging

Scenario: Verify lock/unlock indicators do not confuse users

Given multiple sessions exist (locked and unlocked)
When the user scans the session list
Then locked and unlocked sessions should be clearly distinguishable at a glance
test_cases.acceptance:
Locked and unlocked sessions should be clearly distinguishable at a glance
The behavior should be validated when the user scans the session list.
